title: Sepsis-induced immunosuppression: from cellular dysfunctions to immunotherapy

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Sepsis-induced immunosuppression: from cellular dysfunctions to immunotherapy》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Sepsis - which is a severe life-threatening infection with organ dysfunction - initiates a complex interplay of host pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory processes.

evidence.text: Sepsis - which is a severe life-threatening infection with organ dysfunction - initiates a complex interplay of host pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory processes.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Sepsis-induced immunosuppression: from cellular dysfunctions to immunotherapy》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Biomarker-guided immunotherapy that is administered to patients at the proper immune phase of sepsis is potentially a major advance in the treatment of sepsis and in the field of infectious disease.
